tasks.title: Undo/redo correctness hunt: every mutating feature pushes exactly one coherent history entry; undo restores state faithfully; redo mirrors; no phantom/duplicate entries
tasks.accept: cd apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg && for t in *.test.mjs; do node "$t" > /dev/null || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done
tasks.acceptance_prose:
Bug hunt round 3, slice 1 — undo/redo integrity. Known precedent: BUG2 found phantom undo entries (markDirty without real change) and BUG5 found ops that no-op'd while still pushing history. The 15 feature slices each added mutation paths; undo fidelity across them was never tested.

VERIFIED RECIPE: http.server port 18049 on apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg, playwright via require('/home/weiss/git/World-Office/wo-test-harness/census/node_modules/playwright'), domcontentloaded + 2500ms. IMPORTANT (BUG5 lesson): commit incrementally after each feature group so a timeout retries from green checkpoints, not from zero.

KNOWN CONTEXT (probe to confirm):
- History machinery: grep captureHistory / markDirty / undo stack in editor.js. Undo/redo buttons + Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y/Ctrl+Shift+Z.
- Coalescing: typing bursts may coalesce into one entry (probe semantics — assert consistent, not assumed).

YOUR DELIVERABLES (fix everything found):
1. scripts/undo-deep.mjs probe, feature groups (each: mutate from a KNOWN clean state snapshot, record history depth delta (expect exactly 1 unless coalescing is documented), apply, undo once, compare editor.innerHTML + key state (selection sanity, aria-pressed, object counts) to the snapshot, redo, compare to post-apply state):
   a. text formatting: bold/italic/underline/strike/super/sub, font family/size, color, highlight, clear style, format block H1..quote
   b. alignment/indents/lists: align l/c/r/j, indent/outdent, bullet list, numbered list, multilevel, list restyle (BUG2 fix), paragraph direction
   c. objects: insert table + cell edit, chart (create + edit data + resize via right panel), image (insert + resize + wrap mode), textbox, shape, SmartArt, TextArt, horizontal rule, drop cap, equation, content control add/remove
   d. document structure: page/column/section break, header/footer enter+edit+exit, TOC insert + update, figures TOC, bookmark add/remove, hyperlink add/remove, caption, footnote/endnote, field insert
   e. review/collab: comment add/reply/resolve/delete (undo restores the marker AND model), track-change accept/reject (BUG5 fixed tracked delete — undo a tracked accept must restore the pending change), spell suggestion replace
   f. paste (sanitized hostile HTML) and select-all ops
2. Failures to fix at the history push points (root cause: either don't captureHistory on no-op, or capture state correctly). Phantom-entry class (BUG2 precedent): markDirty/captureHistory called when nothing changed.
3. undo-deep-gate.test.mjs thin static gate. ALL *.test.mjs green (32 files).
4. Commit: 'fix(BUG7-UNDO-DEEP): history fidelity across all mutating features' + body with findings table (feature / symptom / fix).

tasks.title: Multi-surface state consistency + selection/viewport edges: same mutation via right panel vs dialog vs ctx vs keyboard converges; collapsed/cross-cell/in-marker/in-HF selections; narrow-viewport dialogs

tasks.acceptance_prose:
Bug hunt round 2's BUG4 fixed aria-pressed desyncs; the same disease exists for OBJECT state: three surfaces mutate the same object (right panel AF15, dialogs, ctx rows, drag handles, keyboard). BUG8 hunts divergence.

VERIFIED RECIPE: http.server port 18050, playwright absolute-require from harness node_modules, domcontentloaded + 2500ms. Commit incrementally per group (BUG5 lesson).

YOUR DELIVERABLES (fix everything found):
1. scripts/consistency.mjs convergence probes (each object: apply the same mutation via surface A, snapshot; fresh doc, apply via surface B; snapshots must be identical HTML):
   a. image: resize via right-panel width/height inputs vs drag handle vs size dialog; wrap inline/square/behind via panel vs ctx (Layout.Wrapping); alt text via dialog
   b. table: insert 3x3, set cell background via panel vs table-ops dialog vs ctx; border style/width via dialog vs panel; column width via drag vs panel ColWidth; merge cells via ctx vs table-ops; row height
   c. chart: type switch via chart-design tab vs right panel vs edit-dialog; title on/off + data edit via dialog vs panel
   d. paragraph: indents/spacing via right panel vs paragraph dialog vs ruler (probe if ruler drag exists); list indent via ctx AdjustListIndents vs dialog
   e. right-panel REACTIVITY (the mirror direction BUG4 fixed for buttons): select object -> panel shows its current values (change image width via handle -> panel input value follows without reopening)
2. Selection edge probes (each: no pageerror, correct outcome, no lost content):
   a. collapsed selection: apply bold/color/list/table-insert (probe semantics; assert consistent + no crash)
   b. selection across table cells + out of table; across a chart/image; across misspelled span boundary (apply bold — span must not corrupt markers); into header/footer region (HF mode entry via dblclick BUG2 precedent)
   c. select-all then: apply list, insert object, paste, delete; inside ctx spell row with selection spanning two misspelled words
3. Viewport probes: viewport 800x600 — open EVERY dialog (BUG2 opener map), assert each fits (dialog rect within viewport or scrollable, not clipped off-screen), ribbon buttons reachable, ctx menu opens within viewport near edge; 1280x720 spot check.
4. consistency-gate.test.mjs thin static gate. ALL *.test.mjs green (33 files).
5. Commit: 'fix(BUG8-STATE-CONSISTENCY): multi-surface convergence, selection edges, viewport dialog fit' + findings table.

tasks.title: Rust converter contract hunt: wo-html must round-trip the editor's REAL emitted markup (document-semantic attrs, objects, HF, TOC); zero-test serializer gets contract tests; close the data-textdir follow-up
tasks.accept: cargo test -p wo-html -p wo-common 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -qE 'test result: ok' && cd apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg && for t in *.test.mjs; do node "$t" > /dev/null || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done
tasks.acceptance_prose:
Bug hunt round 3, slice 3 — the Rust side has NEVER been hunted by af. Known real finding from BUG3 (2026-10-26): wo-html parses dir/style for text direction but the editor emits data-textdir — direction does not survive conversion. Also: wo-html has ZERO unit tests in-crate (serializer.rs 1821 lines, roundtrip.rs 85).

VERIFIED CONTEXT:
- `cargo test -p wo-html` builds + runs in ~25s (nightly via rust-toolchain.toml — just run cargo, no toolchain fiddling).
- Editor semantic markup contract (BUG3 DOC_SEMANTIC_DATA_ATTRS): data-kind, data-spec, data-author, data-replies, data-resolved, data-id, data-comment, data-cc, data-name, data-title, data-textdir + classes wo-misspelled(stripped pre-save), comments spans, chart/equation/smartart objects as img[data-kind][data-spec], header/footer parts, TOC nav data-kind=toc/figures, drop caps, text art. Probe the real saved payload shape in editor.js (flatHtml + stripEditorInternals + DOC_SEMANTIC_DATA_ATTRS).
- Rust nightly fmt/clippy: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy -p wo-html -- -D warnings if clean already (don't introduce new lints; do NOT run clippy workspace-wide).

YOUR DELIVERABLES (fix everything found):
1. Editor side (small, do FIRST, commit): emit BOTH data-textdir AND dir attribute on text-direction ops (dir is the standard attr wo-html parses; data-textdir stays for editor state) — root-cause close of the BUG3 follow-up. Verify round-trip in the editor: set direction, serialize via the save path, assert dir= present. Update roundtrip.test.mjs allowlist assertions if they enumerate attrs.
2. Rust contract tests (core/crates/wo-html): a fixtures module with the editor's REAL payload fragments (header/footer part, TOC nav, figures nav, comment span with data-author/replies/resolved, content control data-cc, chart img[data-kind][data-spec], equation, drop cap, RTL paragraph dir=rtl, misspell-stripped text). For each: parse via wo-html's entry points (probe parser.rs API) -> serialize back -> assert semantic survives (attr name + value). Assert the attr allowlist in the serializer covers every DOC_SEMANTIC_DATA_ATTRS name (a direct table test — this is the contract).
3. Run cargo test -p wo-html: fix every failure the new tests surface in parser/serializer (root cause; keep diffs minimal; respect existing architecture — read AGENTS.md in core/crates if present).
4. Editor-side regression: scripts/converter-contract.mjs NOT needed — instead extend roundtrip.test.mjs statically (dir= emission assert) and add the Rust fixtures as the shared contract.
5. Commit: 'fix(BUG9-CONVERTER-CONTRACT): editor dir emission + wo-html semantic contract tests' + findings table (which attrs/markup did NOT survive and the fixes).
ALL *.test.mjs green (33) AND cargo test -p wo-html -p wo-common green.
